title: The subcategory of pro-etale complexes with an etale origin
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme and let $\Lambda$ be a finite discrete commutative ring, for instance one of the finite coefficient rings $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Write $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ for the derived category of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small pro-etale site of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and $D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ for its full subcategory of complexes whose cohomology sheaves vanish below some integer [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] (for a finite discrete $\Lambda$ the coefficient sheaf $U\mapsto\operatorname{Cont}(\pi_0(|U|),\Lambda)$ of that node is the sheafification of the constant presheaf $\Lambda$, so the two nodes describe the same category). Write $D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ for the bounded-below derived category of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and $
u_T^*:D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)	o D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ for the derived pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback] along the comparison morphism of sites $
u_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}	o T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], which applies the exact inverse image $
u_T^*$ of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules termwise. The category $\mathcal D^{+}_{\mathrm{et}}(T,\Lambda)$ of *complexes coming from the etale site* has as objects the triples $(K,L,\alpha)$ with $K\in D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, $L\in D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ and $\alpha:
u_T^*L\xrightarrow{\sim}K$ an isomorphism in $D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, that is, an etale-origin witness $(L,\alpha)$ for $K$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]; a morphism $(K,L,\alpha)	o(K',L',\alpha')$ is a morphism $K	o K'$ in $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, with the identities and composition of $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$; that is, $\mathcal D^{+}_{\mathrm{et}}(T,\Lambda)$ is the category induced [def-sf-induced-category] from $D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ by the function $(K,L,\alpha)\mapsto K$ on the class of triples. The forgetful functor $\mathcal D^{+}_{\mathrm{et}}(T,\Lambda)	o D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, $(K,L,\alpha)\mapsto K$, is the induced functor; it is fully faithful [def-sf-induced-category], and its essential image is the class of objects admitting an etale-origin witness; through it $\mathcal D^{+}_{\mathrm{et}}(T,\Lambda)$ is regarded as a full subcategory of $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, and a functor defined on $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ is restricted to $\mathcal D^{+}_{\mathrm{et}}(T,\Lambda)$ by precomposition with the forgetful functor. The witness $(L,\alpha)$, and not only its existence, is part of the object and is carried along whenever a construction transports it.
